# VerilogDB Other | Module: access_control
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • reset: input (1-bit)
  • load_password: input (1-bit)
  • pushButtonLoad_RNG: input (1-bit)
  • pushButtonLoad2: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] passinput4bit: input (4-bit)
  • timeout: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • load_sig_RNG: output (1-bit)
  • load_sig_2: output (1-bit)
  • reconfig: output (1-bit)
  • enable: output (1-bit)
  • passredled: output (1-bit)
  • passgreenled: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements an access control state machine that authenticates a user via a predefined 4-bit password sequence and subsequently controls game start, pause, reconfiguration, timeout events, and corresponding LED and load signals.

# VerilogDB SoC Integration Components | Module: dbg_sync_clk1_clk2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk1: input (1-bit)
  • clk2: input (1-bit)
  • reset1: input (1-bit)
  • reset2: input (1-bit)
  • set2: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • sync_out: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module synchronizes a set signal between two distinct clock domains (clk1 and clk2) by double-flop sampling in each domain while managing reset and clearing signals to produce a stable output.

# VerilogDB Peripheral Interfaces | Module: ac97_soc
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • ps_ce: input (1-bit)
  • resume: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • suspended: output (1-bit)
  • sync: output (1-bit)
  • [5:0] out_le: output (6-bit)
  • [2:0] in_valid: output (3-bit)
  • ld: output (1-bit)
  • valid: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module manages AC'97 timing by generating synchronization signals and controlling slot latch enables, input validity, suspend detection, and resume signaling.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: butterfly_raw
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rstn: input (1-bit)
  • en: input (1-bit)
  • [23:0] xp_real: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xp_imag: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xq_real: input (24-bit)
  • [23:0] xq_imag: input (24-bit)
  • [15:0] factor_real: input (16-bit)
  • [15:0] factor_imag: input (16-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • valid: output (1-bit)
  • [23:0] yp_real: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yp_imag: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yq_real: output (24-bit)
  • [23:0] yq_imag: output (24-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a complex butterfly operation by multiplying one input with a twiddle factor, delaying the other input, and then computing sum and difference results while adjusting bit-width by discarding lower bits.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: xram_16x64
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] wr_addr: input (4-bit)
  • [63:0] wr_data: input (64-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [63:0] rd_data: output (64-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module implements a 16x64 memory that writes 64-bit data on a clock's rising edge when enabled and continuously outputs data from the addressed memory location.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: aes_sbox
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] a: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] d: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements the AES S-box by mapping an 8-bit input to its corresponding 8-bit substitution value using a case statement.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__sdlclkp_4
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • SCE: input (1-bit)
  • GATE: input (1-bit)
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • GCLK: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module instantiates a gated clock generator that produces a gated clock (GCLK) by controlling the clock (CLK) signal with scan enable (SCE) and gate (GATE) inputs while correctly managing power and ground connections.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: isp_blc
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • pclk: input (1-bit)
  • rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] black_r: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_gr: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_gb: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] black_b: input (8-bit)
  • in_href: input (1-bit)
  • in_vsync: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] in_raw: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • out_href: output (1-bit)
  • out_vsync: output (1-bit)
  • [7:0] out_raw: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module performs sensor black-level correction on Bayer-pattern raw image data by using pixel and line parity to determine color format and subtract the corresponding black level before outputting synchronized, adjusted pixel values.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: hex_to_7seg
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] hex: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • a: output (1-bit)
  • b: output (1-bit)
  • c: output (1-bit)
  • d: output (1-bit)
  • e: output (1-bit)
  • f: output (1-bit)
  • g: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module converts a 4-bit hexadecimal input into seven output signals that appropriately control a seven-segment display to show digits 0 through F.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: vedic4
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] p: input (4-bit)
  • [3:0] q: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] out: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a 4x4-bit multiplier by partitioning the inputs into 2x2 segments, using Vedic 2x2 multipliers and ripple carry adders to sum partial products and produce an 8-bit output.

# VerilogDB Peripheral Interfaces | Module: vga_controller
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [63:0] boardR: input (64-bit)
  • [63:0] boardB: input (64-bit)
  • [63:0] boardM: input (64-bit)
  • [2:0] coordX: input (3-bit)
  • [2:0] coordY: input (3-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • vga_h_sync: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module generates VGA synchronization signals and renders an 8×8 Reversi board by drawing white, yellow, red, blue, or green squares based on the current move, valid moves, and board state.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: ztex_ufm1_15d3
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • fxclk_in: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] read: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] write: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module shifts incoming 8-bit data into a buffer for a mining engine that computes cryptographic hashes and nonces, then synchronizes and outputs the results via clock management using DCM and PLL.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: cdc_fifo
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • wr_clk: input (1-bit)
  • rd_clk: input (1-bit)
  • wr_rst: input (1-bit)
  • rd_rst: input (1-bit)
  • rd_en: input (1-bit)
  • wr_en: input (1-bit)
  • [31:0] wr_data: input (32-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • wr_full: output (1-bit)
  • rd_empty: output (1-bit)
  • [31:0] rd_data: output (32-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a clock-domain crossing FIFO that safely transfers data between asynchronous systems by synchronizing read and write pointers, managing memory access, and indicating full or empty statuses.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: xc_aessub_sbox_fwd
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] in: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] out: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements the forward AES S-box transformation using a combinational logic circuit composed of bitwise XOR, AND, and inversion operations, mapping an 8-bit input byte to a substituted 8-bit output byte according to the AES specification.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlclkp_2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • GATE: input (1-bit)
  • CLK: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • GCLK: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module wraps and instantiates a base clock gating cell by connecting clock, gate, and power signals to produce a gated clock signal for controlled clock distribution.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: pong_disp_top
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • hsync: output (1-bit)
  • vsync: output (1-bit)
  • [11:0] rgb: output (12-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module generates VGA synchronization signals and dynamically produces Pong game graphics by combining a VGA timing generator with a graphics generator, updating the RGB display output on each tick.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: clock_mux
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk1: input (1-bit)
  • clk2: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • sel: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • clk_out: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module uses double-flop synchronizers to safely propagate an asynchronous select signal across clock domains and combine inverted gated versions of clk1 and clk2, thereby enabling glitch-free clock multiplexing based on the select input.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: alu_input_stage
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] prio_cmd: input (4-bit)
  • [31:0] prio_data1: input (32-bit)
  • [31:0] prio_data2: input (32-bit)
  • [3:0] alu_cmd: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [63:0] alu_data1: output (64-bit)
  • [63:0] alu_data2: output (64-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module routes 32-bit priority input data into the upper half of 64-bit ALU data outputs, zeros the lower half, and passes a 4-bit priority command to the ALU command output.

# VerilogDB Custom Accelerators and IP Blocks | Module: isp_gamma
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • pclk: input (1-bit)
  • rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • in_href: input (1-bit)
  • in_vsync: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] in_data: input (8-bit)
  • cfg_table_clk: input (1-bit)
  • cfg_table_wen: input (1-bit)
  • cfg_table_ren: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] cfg_table_addr: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] cfg_table_wdata: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • out_href: output (1-bit)
  • out_vsync: output (1-bit)
  • [7:0] out_data: output (8-bit)
  • [7:0] cfg_table_rdata: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements gamma correction on video pixel data by using a dual-port RAM lookup table, delaying control signals and outputting corrected pixel values in sync with the pixel clock.

# VerilogDB Memory Components | Module: fifo_using_dualport
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • wr_en: input (1-bit)
  • rd_en: input (1-bit)
  • [7:0] fifo_in: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] fifo_out: output (8-bit)
  • full: output (1-bit)
  • empty: output (1-bit)
  • almost_full: output (1-bit)
  • almost_empty: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a FIFO using a dual-port RAM by incrementing write and read pointers on clock edges while outputting data and asserting full, empty, almost full, and almost empty status conditions.

# VerilogDB Security and Crypto Blocks | Module: xc_aessub_sbox
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] in: input (8-bit)
  • inv: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] out: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module performs an AES S-Box substitution by selecting either a forward or inverse lookup based on the inv control signal.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: dpll
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • SignalIn: input (1-bit)
  • MainClock: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • SignalOut: output (1-bit)
  • Positive: output (1-bit)
  • Lead: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a digital phase-locked loop by using a phase comparator assessing lead and lag between an input signal and clock, a variable-reset random walk filter generating positive and negative outputs, and a frequency divider synchronizing the output.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: ps2
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk_i: input (1-bit)
  • rst_i: input (1-bit)
  • ps2_clk_i: input (1-bit)
  • ps2_data_i: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [15:0] ps2_data_o: output (16-bit)
  • [1:0] ps2_break_o: output (2-bit)
  • ps2_done_o: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module decodes PS/2 signals by sampling serial data from the clock and data lines, assembling the 11-bit frame into a byte, and distinguishing make, single break, and double break codes to output the appropriate status.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: fcmp
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [31:0] opa: input (32-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • unordered: output (1-bit)
  • altb: output (1-bit)
  • inf: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a 32-bit floating-point comparator that evaluates two operands—including handling special cases like infinities, NaNs, and zeros—to output signals indicating whether one is greater than, less than, or equal to the other.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: bit_8_vedic
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [7:0] in1: input (8-bit)
  • [7:0] in2: input (8-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [15:0] out: output (16-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module multiplies two 8-bit numbers by using four 4-bit Vedic multipliers to compute and shift partial products which are then added to produce the final 16-bit product.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: cde_clock_gater
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk_in: input (1-bit)
  • enable: input (1-bit)
  • atg_clk_mode: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • clk_out: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module gates the input clock by latching an OR of enable signals when the clock is low and AND’ing the latched result with the clock, so that the output is active only when the clock is high and the enable condition is met.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: time_analysis
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • RST: input (1-bit)
  • [31:0] time_cnt: input (32-bit)
  • start: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • busy: output (1-bit)
  • TxD: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module accepts a 32-bit time count, converts each 4-bit nibble into its corresponding hexadecimal ASCII character (appending a newline after eight digits), and serially transmits these bytes via RS232 while managing busy signaling.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: f33m_add
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] a: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [3:0] c: output (4-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module splits two multi-bit inputs into three segments each, performs parallel additions on corresponding segments using f3m_add submodules, and concatenates the results to produce the final output c.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: kogge_stone_30
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [29:0] in1: input (30-bit)
  • [29:0] in2: input (30-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [29:0] sum: output (30-bit)
  • cout: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a 30‐bit Kogge-Stone adder using parallel prefix logic built with black and gray cells to rapidly compute the sum and carry-out of two 30-bit binary inputs.

# VerilogDB Clock and Power Management Units | Module: e203_subsys_gfcm
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • test_mode: input (1-bit)
  • clk0_rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • clk1_rst_n: input (1-bit)
  • sel1: input (1-bit)
  • clk0: input (1-bit)
  • clk1: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • clkout: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module synchronizes and cross-couples two clock domains using multi-stage flip-flop delays and gated enables to select and combine their outputs into a single clock signal.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: f33m_mult
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [3:0] a: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [3:0] c: output (4-bit)
  • done: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a finite field multiplier that partitions two 3-component inputs, computes six partial products and intermediate sums using Karatsuba-like techniques, and combines them into a final product with a completion signal.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: sky130_fd_sc_hd__lpflow_inputiso1n_1
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • A: input (1-bit)
  • SLEEP_B: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • X: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module instantiates a base input isolation cell, connecting data, sleep control, and power/ground signals to produce an isolated output.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: kogge_stone_9
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [8:0] in1: input (9-bit)
  • [8:0] in2: input (9-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [8:0] sum: output (9-bit)
  • cout: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a 9-bit Kogge-Stone adder that computes carries in logarithmic time by combining generate and propagate signals across multiple levels using black and gray cells to produce the final sum and carry outputs.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: s27
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • GND: input (1-bit)
  • VDD: input (1-bit)
  • CK: input (1-bit)
  • G0: input (1-bit)
  • G1: input (1-bit)
  • G2: input (1-bit)
  • G3: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • G17: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This sequential circuit uses three clocked D flip-flops and interdependent combinational logic (including NOT, AND, OR, NAND, and NOR gates) to update internal states and produce output G17 as a function of the primary inputs.

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: mas_sla_jk
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • j: input (1-bit)
  • k: input (1-bit)
  • clk: input (1-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • q: output (1-bit)
  • qn: output (1-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • The module implements a master-slave JK flip-flop that uses complementary clock phases and gated J/K signals to determine q and its complement, ensuring edge-triggered bistable behavior.

# VerilogDB Combinational Logic Designs | Module: booth_algorithm
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • [3:0] Q: input (4-bit)
  • [3:0] M: input (4-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [7:0] result: output (8-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module implements a signed 4-bit Booth multiplication algorithm by iteratively examining bit pairs from the multiplier and conditionally adding or subtracting the multiplicand into an accumulator, then performing arithmetic right shifts to compute the final 8-bit product.

# VerilogDB Sequential Logic Designs | Module: f36m_cubic
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • [6:0] a: input (7-bit)
## 2. Đầu ra (Outputs):
  • [6:0] c: output (7-bit)
## 3. Hoạt động / Logic mong muốn (VerilogDB arXiv:2507.13369):
  • This module partitions input "a" into three segments, computes each segment's cube using submodules, and concatenates the most significant cube, the difference between a1³ and a2³, and the sum of all cubes to form output "c".

# VerilogDB Basic Digital Building Blocks | Module: ts_serial_out
## 1. Đầu vào (Inputs):
  • clk: input (1-bit)
  • rst: input (1-bit)
  • [1:0] group: input (2-bit)
  • [3:0] bytes: input (4-bit)
  • en: input (1-bit)
